instruction: The world's largest assembly- and fastener-technology company is a German group headquartered in a town in Baden-Wuerttemberg. Name the ventilation-technology world market leader (a family company) headquartered in that same town.

verification.one_shot_breaks: candidate-breaks (Ziehl-Abegg only findable once Kuenzelsau is known; short-circuit risk: 'ventilation world market leader Germany' -> Ziehl-Abegg directly -> confirm via check)

provenance.note: Cluster chain: fastener leader -> Wuerth/Kuenzelsau -> ventilation world leader there -> Ziehl-Abegg.
